notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: Remi Lane Zoning Map Amendment Request
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on October 29, 2026 on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Remi Lane Zoning Map Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the Planning Commission to consider the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 999 E 13200 S The purpose of the request is to rearrange the existing split zoning of the property, currently zoned both RA1 (Residential Agricultural) and RA2 (Residential Agricultural), to accommodate a future planned subdivision of the property. 

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on November 12, 2026 at 6:30 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Todd Draper at (801) 576-6335 or todd.draper@draperutah.gov.  

Dated this 29th Day of October, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing: Concord Farm Lane Zoning Map, Land Use Map and Development Agreement Amendment Requests
notices.agenda_text:
Posted on October 29, 2026 on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Concord Farm Lane Zoning Map, Land Use Map and Development Agreement Amendment Requests

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the Planning Commission to consider the above listed requests.  The property is located at approximately 13720 S. 300 East.  The purpose of the request is for a: 1) a Zoning Map Amendment from the RA1 (Residential Agricultural, 40,000 square foot lot minimum) to the RM1 (Multi-family Residential, up to 8 dwelling units per acre), 2) a Land Use Map Amendment from the Residential Low/Medium Density designation to the Residential Medium/High Density designation, and 3) a Development Agreement Amendment to incorporate the four proposed lots into the existing Concord Farm Lane subdivision.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers on November 12, 2026, at 6:30 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Maryann DeHaven at (801) 576-6391 or maryann.dehaven@draperutah.gov.

Dated this 29th Day of October, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the Planning Commission to consider the above listed request.  The property is located at approximately 12430 S. 700 East.
